summary: Anthropic introduced Agent Skills, a feature letting Claude load folders of instructions, scripts and resources to specialize in tasks across Claude apps, Claude Code and the API.

mechanisms.reason: Skills let Claude compose and execute code-backed capabilities autonomously, and a partner explicitly frames this as enabling deeper agentic workflows.
mechanisms.quote: This unlocks new ways to bring Canva deeper into agentic workflows—helping teams capture their unique context and create stunning, high-quality designs effortlessly.
